intro: The New Plague is a research endeavor undertaken by Theodore Griffs within the Apothecarium of the Undercity. Investigating reports of a lethal arthropod in the ruins above whose venom consumes even undead flesh, Griffs seeks to analyze and reverse engineer the organism's deadly toxins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Welcome to the most vital organ of the Undercity: The Apothecarium! Here we experiment on the most virulent of Azeroth's exotic specimens.

You've caught me in a good mood, so I will let you in on my latest investigation. It appears there is a particularly venomous arthropod stalking the ruins above our fair city. Its toxins are said to eat through even undead flesh. How exhilarating!
I wish to validate these claims. Should you find yourself withering away from its bite, I should love a sample.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Any fool can tell you the most potent transmission method will always be through the blood.
I must see this strain for myself!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hmmph. Lucky for you this should be enough ichor to reverse engineer its properties. I would have expected more from a fellow alchemist.
